newsitem.title: USA: Downey Financial sets 3 for 2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Downey Financial sets 3 for 2 stock split.

text.p: Downey Financial Corp Tuesday said its board of directors approved a three-for-two split of its common stock.

In a statement, the company said the split will be in the form of a stock dividend, with one additional common share issued on Dec. 12, for every two common shares held by shareholders of record on Nov. 15.

Shareholders will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares based on the record date closing stock price and adjusted to reflect the shares outstanding after the three- for-two stock split. Upon completion of the stock split, there will be approximately 25.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.
